author: Mohamed Elatabany
promise: Your plan for the next urge. Private. Secular. No brain myths.
facts: Ballast is an on-device iPhone app (iOS 26 or later) for adults who want to quit porn and compulsive masturbation (PMO). It offers a one-tap iOS adult-website filter, if-then urge plans and progress that a slip cannot erase. The full urge flow, slip support and the filter are free. There is no account and no server. Personal entries stay on device; Apple and RevenueCat process purchases. It uses skills from CBT and ACT. It is not treatment.
